title: Gemma 3 Technical Report
paper_type_zh: 开放权重前沿模型技术报告与数据反馈台账
best_for_zh: 研究知识蒸馏、human-feedback RM、程序化奖励、QAT、记忆审计与开放权重许可边界的读者
one_line: Gemma 3 discloses 2T-14T pretraining, 256 teacher logits per token, large-IT-teacher distillation, mixed human/code/math RL rewards, QAT, and open weights, but not corpora, preferences, RMs, teachers, rollouts, or verifiers.
Gemma 3 披露 1B/4B/12B/27B 的 2T–14T token 预训练、每 token 256 个 teacher logits、large-IT-teacher 蒸馏、human/code/math 混合 reward、QAT 与开放权重，但未公开 corpus、preference、RM、teacher、rollout 或 verifier。
why: It shows that open weight access is much broader than the underlying data, distillation, reward, and verifier disclosure.
inclusion_reason: An open-weight frontier report disclosing token scale, sparse teacher-logit distillation, mixed human/code/math rewards, safety alignment, QAT, and memorization audit while withholding record-level data and reward assets.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The 2025 Gemma 3 Technical Report documents open-weight 1B, 4B, 12B, and 27B models; the larger three combine a decoder with a frozen roughly 400M-parameter SigLIP vision encoder. Pretraining budgets are respectively 2T, 4T, 12T, and 14T tokens. The report, official model card, checkpoint, code, and terms are public, but training records and feedback assets are not.

The Atlas problem is to distinguish open checkpoints from an open training pipeline. Each pretraining token is supervised by 256 sampled teacher logits, while post-training uses a large IT teacher followed by improved BOND/WARM/WARP-style RL with weight-averaged human-feedback reward models, code execution, mathematical ground truth, and safety SFT/RLHF. Teacher identities, preferences, reward models, tests, math checker, rollouts, and RL settings remain private.

A record may contain source text/image, sampled teacher token IDs/probabilities, an instruction/response, a human preference or safety label, an RM score, code execution feedback, or a math-correctness reward. The exact schema, mixture, generator, and lineage are unreleased. This Card reaches L4 by documenting both the concrete supervision objects and the missing assets rather than treating weights or benchmark scores as data disclosure.

2025 年 Gemma 3 Technical Report 描述开放权重的 1B、4B、12B、27B 模型；后三者把 decoder 与冻结的约 400M-parameter SigLIP vision encoder 结合。预训练预算分别为 2T、4T、12T、14T tokens。报告、官方 model card、checkpoint、代码和条款公开，但训练记录与反馈资产不公开。

Atlas 问题是区分开放 checkpoint 与开放训练 pipeline。每个预训练 token 接收 256 个 sampled teacher logits；后训练使用 large IT teacher，然后采用 improved BOND/WARM/WARP-style RL，反馈来自 weight-averaged human-feedback reward model、code execution、mathematical ground truth 与 safety SFT/RLHF。Teacher identity、preference、RM、test、math checker、rollout 和 RL 设置仍私有。

一条记录可能包含 source text/image、sampled teacher token ID/probability、instruction/response、human preference/safety label、RM score、code execution feedback 或 math-correctness reward。确切 schema、mixture、generator 与 lineage 未发布。本 Card 通过同时记录具体 supervision object 与缺失资产达到 L4，而不把权重或 benchmark score 当作数据披露。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Gemma 3's central data mechanism is sparse-logit distillation at scale: sample 256 logits per token according to teacher probability, zero unsampled logits, renormalize, and train the student with cross-entropy. The teacher checkpoint and serving/query budget are unknown, so the target distribution is concrete while its source is not.

Instruction tuning then combines improved distillation from an undisclosed large IT teacher with RL derived from improved BOND, WARM, and WARP. Feedback families are weight-averaged human-feedback RMs, code execution, math ground truth, and safety-oriented preferences. These observe preference, executability, answer correctness, or policy compliance; they do not automatically establish faithful reasoning or absence of contamination.

The report never explicitly says post-training distillation is online or on-policy. Cited methods cannot supply missing rollout facts. The direction signal is mixed learned/programmatic feedback applied across model scales, followed by QAT and open checkpoint release; the main boundary is that data and reward infrastructure remain closed.

Gemma 3 的核心数据机制是规模化 sparse-logit distillation：按 teacher probability 为每个 token 采样 256 个 logits，把未采样项置零并重新归一化，再用 cross-entropy 训练 student。Teacher checkpoint 与 serving/query budget 未知，因此 target distribution 具体而来源不透明。

Instruction tuning 随后结合未披露 large IT teacher 的 improved distillation，以及基于 improved BOND、WARM、WARP 的 RL。反馈族包括 weight-averaged human-feedback RM、code execution、math ground truth 与 safety preference。它们分别观察偏好、可执行性、答案正确性或 policy compliance，但不能自动证明 faithful reasoning 或没有污染。

报告从未明确说明后训练蒸馏是 online 或 on-policy；不能用引用方法补足缺失 rollout 事实。方向信号是跨模型规模混合 learned/programmatic feedback，再进行 QAT 和开放 checkpoint；核心边界是数据与 reward infrastructure 仍封闭。

title: Method
方法
html:
The disclosed pipeline is:

  1. Pretraining data: filtered/reweighted/decontaminated web, code, math, multilingual text, and images. Train 1B/4B/12B/27B on 2T/4T/12T/14T tokens. Larger models extend 32K sequences to 128K late in training.
  2. Sparse teacher supervision: for each token, sample 256 teacher logits by probability, zero the rest, renormalize, and use cross-entropy. Teacher identity, checkpoint, temperature, cache/online mode, and query count are unknown.
  3. Instruction tuning: distill from an undisclosed large IT teacher, then apply improved BOND/WARM/WARP-style RL. Weight-averaged human-feedback RMs, code execution, and math ground truth provide rewards; safety uses SFT and RLHF. Modifications, stage order, rollout policy/count, optimizer, KL, coefficients, batch, LR, and selection/merge rules are unknown.
  4. QAT: adapt data to PT/IT distributions and typically fine-tune 5,000 steps using non-quantized checkpoint probabilities as teacher targets; release per-channel/per-block int4 and switched-fp8 formats.
  5. Audit/release: evaluate capability/safety and memorization, then release PT/IT/raw/quantized weights plus inference/fine-tuning libraries.

Code execution and math checking are named but no sandbox, languages, dependencies, tests, timeout, equivalence parser, partial credit, or reward aggregation is disclosed. Public PyTorch/JAX libraries are not the internal training stack.

已披露流程如下：

  1. 预训练数据： 经过过滤、重加权和去污染的网页、代码、数学、多语文本与图像。1B/4B/12B/27B 分别使用 2T/4T/12T/14T 个词元训练；大模型在训练后期把序列长度从 32K 扩展至 128K。
  2. 稀疏教师监督： 每个词元按概率采样 256 个教师 logits，其余置零并重新归一化，再使用交叉熵。教师身份、检查点、温度、缓存/在线模式与查询次数未知。
  3. 指令微调： 先从未披露的大型 IT 教师模型蒸馏，再使用改进的 BOND/WARM/WARP 式 RL。权重平均的人类反馈 RM、代码执行与数学标准答案提供奖励；安全训练使用 SFT/RLHF。具体修改、阶段顺序、采样展开策略/次数、优化器、KL、系数、批大小、LR 与选择/合并规则均未知。
  4. QAT： 数据适配 PT/IT 分布，通常训练 5,000 步，以非量化检查点的概率分布作为教师目标；发布按通道/按块 int4 与 switched-fp8。
  5. 审计/发布： 完成能力、安全与记忆评测后，发布 PT/IT 原始/量化权重以及推理/微调库。

代码执行与数学校验虽被命名，但沙箱、语言、依赖、测试、超时、等价性解析器、部分得分与奖励聚合均未披露。公开的 PyTorch/JAX 库不是内部训练技术栈。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Section 2.2 reports 2T/4T/12T/14T pretraining tokens for 1B/4B/12B/27B and 256 sampled teacher logits per token. Section 2.3 reports QAT typically lasting 5,000 steps with the non-quantized checkpoint as teacher. These are training conditions; teacher identity, data mixture, optimizer, and QAT data proportions remain unknown.

Section 3 names a large IT teacher, improved BOND/WARM/WARP-based RL, weight-averaged human-feedback RMs, code execution, and math ground-truth reward. It reports no online/on-policy status, rollout count, RM component count, reward weights, code tests, or math equivalence rules. MATH zero-shot results are 48.0/75.6/83.8/89.0 and HumanEval zero-shot 41.5/71.3/85.4/87.8 for 1B/4B/12B/27B, but these are aggregate outcomes, not component ablations or evidence about training records.

Section 6 samples a private training-data subsample, provides a 50-token prefix, and tests a 50-token suffix for exact match or approximate match within 10% edit distance. Approximate memorization is reported as about 24 times exact memorization on average, mainly in comparative/log-scale form without exact per-model rates. No personal information was detected among memorized outputs by Sensitive Data Protection, meaning below that detector's threshold rather than proof that the corpus contains no personal data.

第 2.2 节报告 1B/4B/12B/27B 分别使用 2T/4T/12T/14T 个预训练词元，并对每个词元采样 256 个教师 logits。第 2.3 节报告 QAT 通常训练 5,000 步，以非量化检查点作为教师模型。这些是训练条件；教师身份、数据混合、优化器与 QAT 数据占比仍未知。

第 3 节提到大型 IT 教师模型、改进的 BOND/WARM/WARP 式 RL、权重平均的人类反馈 RM、代码执行与数学标准答案奖励，却没有披露在线/在策略状态、采样展开次数、RM 组件数量、奖励权重、代码测试或数学等价规则。1B/4B/12B/27B 的 MATH 零样本成绩为 48.0/75.6/83.8/89.0，HumanEval 零样本成绩为 41.5/71.3/85.4/87.8；这些是汇总结果，不是组件消融或训练记录证据。

第 6 节从私有训练数据子样本中提取 50 词元前缀，并检查 50 词元后缀的精确匹配或编辑距离在 10% 以内的近似匹配。报告称近似记忆平均约为精确记忆的 24 倍，结果主要以比较图和对数刻度形式给出，未提供各模型的精确比率。Sensitive Data Protection（敏感数据保护）评测未在记忆输出中检测到个人信息，这只表示结果低于该检测器阈值，并不能证明语料库不含个人数据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Knowledge distillation, human-feedback RMs, execution rewards, math rewards, safety RLHF, and QAT all predate Gemma 3. Its distinct contribution is combining them across four open-weight scales while disclosing a precise 256-logit-per-token target and multiple reward families.

The useful data objects are sparse teacher distributions and heterogeneous feedback records, not merely raw web text. This exposes how teacher behavior, preferences, executable tests, mathematical predicates, and safety policies can all shape the checkpoint.

The report does not introduce an open reward stack or reproducible RL algorithm. “Improved BOND/WARM/WARP” omits modifications and rollout/merge rules. Reuse requires teacher IDs, preference records, RM components, sandbox/tests, math equivalence, rollout generation, objective weights, and checkpoint hashes.

知识蒸馏、人类反馈 RM、执行奖励、数学奖励、安全 RLHF 与 QAT 都早于 Gemma 3。其独特贡献是在四种开放权重规模上组合这些方法，并披露精确的每个词元 256 个 logit 的目标表示与多种奖励类型。

有用的数据对象是稀疏教师分布与异构反馈记录，而不只是原始网页文本。这揭示了教师模型行为、偏好、可执行测试、数学判定条件与安全策略如何共同塑造检查点。

报告没有提供开放的奖励技术栈或可复现的 RL 算法。“改进的 BOND/WARM/WARP”省略了修改细节和采样展开/合并规则。复用需要教师模型标识、偏好记录、RM 组件、沙箱/测试、数学等价规则、采样轨迹生成方式、目标权重与检查点哈希。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Training data disclosure stops at broad source classes and token totals. Corpus manifests, source/language/modality weights, images, rights, quality coefficients, prompt/completion counts, preference records, safety labels, and lineage are unknown. Evaluation decontamination has no method, thresholds, removals, or artifact, and the report warns residual contamination may remain.

Both pretraining and IT teachers are unidentified. Their checkpoints, query mode, temperatures, budgets, prompts, and cached-versus-online behavior are unknown. The report does not say IT distillation is online or on-policy. Human-feedback RM components, averaging weights, annotator rubric/agreement, calibration, and reward-hacking/overoptimization tests are unavailable.

Code execution lacks sandbox, tests, languages, dependencies, timeouts, flaky-test handling, isolation, hidden-test leakage controls, and scalar aggregation. Math ground truth lacks task manifest, parser, symbolic/numeric equivalence, partial credit, proof checking, and contamination audit. BOND/WARM/WARP modifications, rollout counts, optimizer, KL, stage order, merge weights, and checkpoint selection are absent.

Memorization records are private and exact per-model rates are not tabulated. The 50-token/10% probe may miss other memorization forms; no detected personal information means only below the chosen detector threshold.

Licenses are separate: the manuscript is CC BY 4.0, official PyTorch code Apache 2.0, and weights are governed by Gemma-specific Terms of Use with gated acceptance. None covers private training corpora, preferences, logits, RMs, tests, or verifiers.

训练数据披露停留在宽泛来源类别和词元总量。语料库清单、来源/语言/模态权重、图像、权利状态、质量系数、提示/补全数量、偏好记录、安全标签与数据谱系未知。评测去污染没有披露方法、阈值、移除记录或产物，且报告警告残余污染仍可能存在。

预训练和 IT 教师模型均未识别；检查点、查询模式、温度、预算、提示以及缓存式与在线式行为未知。报告未说明 IT 蒸馏是否在线或在策略。人类反馈 RM 的组件、平均权重、标注者准则/一致性、校准以及奖励劫持/过度优化测试均不可得。

代码执行缺少沙箱、测试、语言、依赖、超时、不稳定测试处理、隔离机制、隐藏测试泄漏控制与标量聚合。数学标准答案缺少任务清单、解析器、符号/数值等价规则、部分得分、证明校验与污染审计。BOND/WARM/WARP 的修改细节、采样展开次数、优化器、KL、阶段顺序、合并权重与检查点选择均缺失。

记忆记录未公开，也未列出各模型的精确记忆率。50 词元/10% 探针可能漏掉其他记忆形式；未检测到个人信息只表示结果低于选定的检测器阈值。

许可证彼此独立：论文采用 CC BY 4.0，官方 PyTorch 代码采用 Apache 2.0，权重受需要门控式接受的 Gemma 专用使用条款管辖。任何一项都不覆盖私有训练语料库、偏好、logit、RM、测试或验证器。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use the report as a disclosure template for distilled open-weight models: publish token budgets by size, the teacher target representation, post-training teacher role, reward families, QAT stage, memorization protocol, checkpoint types, and separate legal terms.

A reproducible study should release or pin corpus manifests, teachers, sampled logits, IT prompts/responses, preference/RM records, code sandboxes/tests, math parsers, BOND/WARM/WARP modifications, rollouts, optimizer/merge settings, decontamination, and checkpoint hashes. Ablate human RMs, code reward, math reward, and teacher size under matched compute.

For privacy audit, release stratified memorization samples or privacy-preserving aggregates, exact rates, detector thresholds, and false-negative analysis beyond the 50-token/10%-distance probe.

Reuse class: weights and libraries support inference/fine-tuning under their terms; the report supports recipe and audit design. Original training and reward reuse is blocked by unavailable data, environments, models, and licenses.

可把该报告作为蒸馏型开放权重模型的披露模板：按规模发布词元预算、教师目标表示、后训练教师模型角色、奖励类型、QAT 阶段、记忆评测方案、检查点类型与独立法律条款。

可复现研究应发布或固定语料库清单、教师模型、采样 logits、IT 提示/响应、偏好/RM 记录、代码沙箱/测试、数学解析器、BOND/WARM/WARP 修改细节、采样展开记录、优化器/合并设置、去污染记录与检查点哈希。在相同计算量下消融人类 RM、代码奖励、数学奖励与教师模型规模。

隐私审计应发布分层记忆样本或隐私保护的汇总统计、精确记忆率、检测器阈值，以及针对 50 词元/10% 距离探针覆盖范围之外情况的假阴性分析。

复用等级：权重与库可在各自条款下用于推理/微调；报告可支持训练方案与审计设计。因数据、环境、模型与许可证不可得，原始训练与奖励复用被阻断。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Preserve the scale mapping: 1B/4B/12B/27B use 2T/4T/12T/14T tokens; the larger three add a frozen roughly 400M SigLIP encoder.
  • The pretraining target is 256 sampled teacher logits per token; teacher identity and query mode remain unknown.
  • Do not infer online/on-policy rollouts from “large IT teacher” or cited BOND/WARM/WARP work; post-training rollout counts are undisclosed.
  • Keep weight-averaged human RMs, code execution, math ground truth, safety RLHF, and 5,000-step QAT as distinct feedback/stage claims.
  • Read the 50-token prefix/suffix, 10% edit-distance, and approximately 24x memorization result with the private-sample and license boundaries.

• 保留规模映射：1B/4B/12B/27B 使用 2T/4T/12T/14T tokens；后三者加入冻结的约 400M SigLIP encoder。
  • 预训练 target 是每 token 256 个 sampled teacher logits；teacher identity 与 query mode 仍未知。
  • 不要从“large IT teacher”或 BOND/WARM/WARP 引用推断 online/on-policy rollout；后训练 rollout count 未披露。
  • 把 weight-averaged human RM、code execution、math ground truth、safety RLHF 与 5,000-step QAT 保持为不同反馈/阶段主张。
  • 阅读 50-token prefix/suffix、10% edit-distance 与约 24x memorization 结果时，必须保留 private-sample 与 license 边界。
